purpose: Data-integrity expectations for POC-1. These are checks on the feed itself, not on journeys — journey-level edge cases live in journeys.json as J22 (service-day boundary), J23 (no route), J24 (long walk), J25 (Shabbat).
provenance: Derived from docs/data-access-findings.md and the GTFS spec. Each check is a known way Israeli GTFS ingestion goes wrong quietly. Agent A must record a result for every one; 'not observed' is a valid, useful result.

checks.name: HEAD returns a bogus Content-Length
checks.expect: Change detection uses GET plus zip validation. A HEAD-based size check must not appear anywhere in the ingester.
checks.evidence_required: The refresh code path, plus a recorded HEAD vs GET size comparison proving the discrepancy still exists.
checks.source: data-access-findings §1 — HEAD returned 3382 bytes against an actual 164 MB file.

checks.name: Times beyond 24:00:00
checks.expect: Times like 25:30:00 parse as 'service day + 1h30m', never as an error and never truncated to 01:30 on the wrong day.
checks.evidence_required: Count of stop_times rows with hour >= 24, and a round-trip test on the largest observed value.
checks.source: GTFS spec; the single most common transit-data bug.

checks.name: Hebrew encoding round-trip
checks.expect: Hebrew stop and route names survive download → extract → parse → Postgres → read unchanged, byte for byte.
checks.evidence_required: Explicit assertion on at least 20 Hebrew names including ones with quotes, apostrophes (גוריון), and mixed Hebrew/Latin/digits.
checks.source: Plan §8 risk register — this corrupts silently and is found late.

checks.name: translations.txt sanitisation
checks.expect: Documented behaviour, whatever it is. If the file needs cleaning, the cleaning rules are written down rather than applied ad hoc.
checks.evidence_required: Row count, distinct languages present, and any malformed rows quoted verbatim in known-data-problems.md.
checks.source: PRD §13 names this as an expected known data problem.

checks.name: TripIdToDate is versioned with the feed
checks.expect: The ingester refuses to pair a TripIdToDate snapshot with a GTFS snapshot from a different publication.
checks.evidence_required: A test that a mismatched pair is rejected, plus the recorded hashes of the matched pair actually used.
checks.source: data-access-findings §1 and §3 — this file is what makes realtime matching possible.

checks.name: 10-day and 60-day feeds are different products
checks.expect: Only the 60-day feed plus compatible TripIdToDate is loaded (decision D5). The 10-day feed is comparison only. If both are parsed for comparison, the difference in trip and stop_times counts is recorded.
checks.evidence_required: Row counts for both feeds side by side, so the D5 decision is evidenced rather than asserted.

checks.name: Service exceptions in calendar_dates
checks.expect: Shabbat, festival and exception days are honoured. Israeli service is not a simple weekly pattern.
checks.evidence_required: Count of calendar_dates rows by exception_type, and the set of dates in the active window with materially reduced service.
checks.source: Directly determines whether journeys.json J25 can pass.

checks.name: Orphan and dangling references
checks.expect: Every trip references a real route and service; every stop_time references a real trip and stop. Violations are counted, not silently dropped.
checks.evidence_required: A count per violation class. Zero is a fine answer; an unreported non-zero is a failure of the check.
checks.source: Standard GTFS integrity; a silent drop here becomes a mysterious no-route later.

checks.name: Parent stations and stop grouping
checks.expect: Multi-platform stations (Savidor, Tel Aviv CBS) resolve as a station rather than as unrelated scattered platforms.
checks.evidence_required: location_type distribution, and the platform list resolved for corpora stop S01 and S08.
checks.source: stops.json S08 note — sprawling stations are where this breaks.

checks.name: Refresh is genuinely automatic
checks.expect: A cold run on an empty data directory reaches a queryable database with no manual editing. PRD §6 makes this the PASS condition.
checks.evidence_required: A recorded cold run from an empty directory, with wall time and exit status.
checks.source: PRD §6 PASS criterion; also kill criterion #1.
